_comment: English Grade 1 Learner's Book — art spec for tools/genimage.js.
Keys are picNN-<what>: each fills picture slot NN (an artSlots entry in the
overrides), numbered as in the picture brief. genimage.js appends the house style
to every prompt, so each prompt says only what the picture must show.
A slot that already has its `art` (supplied pictures: see _comment_artSlots in the
overrides) has no prompt here, so a generation run can never overwrite it.
Every open slot has a prompt except PIC 64: '-all' in a circle with b, c, w, f, sm, t
around it is a word wheel, all lettering, which the house style forbids in generated
art and which reads better typeset than drawn anyway.
Where the author wanted a word printed on a picture (PIC 43-47: 'one cup and the
word cup on it'), the picture is drawn without it: the book's own text carries the
words, and the model mis-spells lettering.

pic12-cat-cup-duck.prompt: A set of separate spot illustrations on a plain white background, side by side in one row with clear space between them, each one simple and easy for a six-year-old to name: a cat, a cup, a duck.

pic18-school.prompt: A Zambian primary school in one wide scene: on the left, an open classroom with desks, chairs, a chalkboard and books; in the middle, a playground with six-year-old children playing; on the right, a small school office with a teacher at a desk. In front, two learners drop coins into a clay money box, saving money.

pic19-school-sentences.prompt: Four panels in a row, each a small classroom scene with six-year-old Zambian learners: 1. a girl writing in a book at her desk; 2. a boy sitting on a chair, ready to learn; 3. a teacher writing on the chalkboard; 4. two children reading story books together.

pic20-road-coat-soap.prompt: A set of separate spot illustrations on a plain white background, side by side in one row with clear space between them, each one simple and easy for a six-year-old to name: a tarred road curving into the distance, a warm coat on a hanger, a bar of soap.

pic22-domestic-and-wild.prompt: Two halves of one picture. Left half: domestic animals at a Zambian homestead: a cow, a goat, a dog and chickens near a house. Right half: wild animals in the bush: an elephant, a lion, a zebra and a giraffe. A clear gap between the two halves.

pic23-domestic-animals.prompt: Domestic animals at a Zambian village homestead: a cow, a goat, a sheep, a dog, a cat, chickens and a duck, all clearly visible, near a house with a thatched roof.

pic35-th-words.prompt: A six-year-old Zambian girl smiling to show her teeth and holding up three fingers.
